headline: Building permit for a 97 W. Merrimack Street apartment conversion, and a grant for Central High School's National Register listing.
summary: A building permit for 97 W. Merrimack Street would turn a former ground-floor dental office into a two-bedroom apartment, with exterior repairs and sign removal. Discussion will also cover a grant to place Central High School on the National Register of Historic Places.
items: Building permit review for 97 W. Merrimack Street apartment conversion
Certified Local Government grant for Central High School National Register listing
John Clayton term extended to July 1, 2029
location: Walter Stiles Conference Room- City Hall
plain_text:
City of Manchester Heritage Commission 
Meeting Agenda and 
Public Hearing Notice 
 
Meeting Date:  Tuesday, November 24, 2026 
Meeting Time:  5:30 P.M. 
Meeting Location: Walter Stiles Conference Room- City Hall  
 
 
Agenda  
1. Chair calls the meeting to order and Roll Call:  
 
 
2. Regulatory review of a building permit application in the Amoskeag Corporation 
Housing Historic District:  
The owner of 97 W. Merrimack Street, Tax Map 152, Lot 5 (Spacehouse Architecture, LLC for 
Richard Kudler) seeks approval for the conversion of a former ground-floor dental office, to 
add a two-bedroom apartment to the three existing units in the upper floors. While work is 
predominately interior renovation, exterior repair and removal of signage is proposed.   
 
3. Certified Local Government:  
 
The Commission will discuss the Certified Local Government grant to place the Central High 
School on the National Register of Historic Places.  
 Review the awarded grant letter and timeline 
 Review consultant submissions for selection 
 
Additional Business: 
 
1. John Clayton has extended his term July 1, 2029 
2. Approval of meeting minutes 
3. Additional discussion items at the Commissions discretion.  
 
Adjournment:  Without objection, the Chair gavels the meeting to a close.
